product.audience: Frequent design-led travelers choosing luggage by route, trip rhythm and packing demand
product.decision: Select a case size and packing architecture for a specific journey
product.conversion: Issue a fictional route folio with destination, case and packing plan

signature.moment: A curved departure ribbon physically travels through the page and fills a transparent suitcase cross-section according to destination, trip rhythm and duration

systems.hero: Wide airport campaign with an oversized kinetic departure code and moving route ribbon
systems.navigation: Boarding header with live destination and case weight
systems.contentDensity: Editorial travel aspiration followed by precise route and volume planning
systems.geometry: Boarding passes, curved route lines, case ribs, packing cells and departure-board columns
systems.motion: Scroll advances the route ribbon through destinations; controls rearrange packing cells and case fill
systems.coreInteraction: Destination, trip rhythm and duration update the schematic route, climate, distance, case size, fill percentage and recommended packing cells

structuralDifferences: Hero behaves as a stacked departure ticket over one luggage portrait
Route becomes a vertical station line with thumb choices
Packing cells become a tappable case cross-section below the route
Outcome folds into a compact boarding pass in flow

artDirection.typography: Elegant travel serif with condensed departure-board monospace
artDirection.material: Deep oxblood polycarbonate, brushed champagne aluminum, saffron straps and paper boarding stock
artDirection.imageLogic: Original cinematic travel and product images provide narrative; CSS route ribbon and transparent case plan provide interaction
artDirection.microcopy: Departure, sector, connection, volume, shell, cabin, transit and folio
artDirection.dataHonesty: Distances, weights and packing suggestions are illustrative; no ticket or luggage purchase is made
